quotes.t: I despise people who can wrap up their peeing session within a minute.
Believe in your flyness, conquer your shyness.
I feel like I’m too busy writing history to read it.
I still think I am the greatest.
I am Warhol. I am the number one most impactful artist of our generation.
Kanye has repeatedly argued that people should believe in their own creative potential.
He has spoken about treating creativity as a force that can change culture.
He often frames self-belief as a prerequisite for achieving something extraordinary.
He has challenged the idea that artists should stay within the boundaries other people set for them.
He has described fashion, music, architecture and design as interconnected forms of creativity.
He has emphasized the importance of pursuing a vision even when other people don’t understand it.
